prompt:
An authorised municipal sanitary landfill cell at midday near Nagpur, a flat expanse of covered earth, a yellow excavator far behind: in the foreground an agency's supervising officer in an orange hi-vis vest and a white helmet holds a tablet out toward the distributor (the man in the light blue checked shirt, grey moustache), who signs the tablet's screen with his finger, while two independent witnesses (a man in a white shirt and a woman in a blue salwar kameez) stand beside them watching; near their feet a small heap of slit-open solid-colour snack packets and an open plain kraft carton. Medium wide shot, hard sun, a little dust haze.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. Every pack and carton is unbranded: plain kraft-brown cartons with a sage-green band, solid-colour snack packets (amber, green, red) with no lettering, Mango Drink as small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with no lettering. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no number plate anywhere. No children.
